hook: On October 28, 2026, Google connected 50 external apps directly into Gemini.

sections.voiceover: On October 28, 2026, Google connected 50 external apps directly into Gemini.
sections.visual_cue: Graphic displaying the date October 28, 2026 alongside the Google logo and number 50 connected to Gemini.

sections.voiceover: Google announced the Connected Apps Platform preview on October 28, 2026, for Search and Gemini. Which major external partners joined this 50 app integration?
sections.visual_cue: Diagram showing Connected Apps Platform hub distributing to Search, Gemini, Workspace, Photos, and YouTube Music icons.
b_roll: Screen capture of Connected Apps Platform dashboard

sections.voiceover: But TechCrunch reported on October 28, 2026, that these apps go beyond Google Workspace.
sections.visual_cue: Split screen dividing internal Google tools on 1 side and external partner slots on the other.

sections.voiceover: Google's platform brought over 50 live apps from partners including Adobe, Experian, Localiza, and Peloton. These 4 companies gave Gemini tools beyond Google Home. That brings more than 50 live apps across 2 separate Google platforms.
sections.visual_cue: Grid animation displaying logos for Adobe, Experian, Localiza, and Peloton connecting to Search and Google Home.
b_roll: Adobe and Peloton partner logos graphic

sections.voiceover: Now 50 connected apps operate inside Google Search and Gemini.
sections.visual_cue: Summary card showing 50 live apps integrated across Google Search and Gemini platforms.
b_roll: Google Search and Gemini final hero shot
